title: Burned Log Ash
warm:
Burned log ash from Rhea Quinn's grate arrived as forensics soft enough to deny and hard enough to smell—Crownspire concierge fire where guest-log marks should have lived. [player_name] stood with Nolan Greer in the service hush while Detective Imani Brooks's colder interest rose without a body. Vivienne weekly-to-monthly-to-gone had been paper; now some of that paper was carbon.

"Rhea burned what she thought would save the building," Nolan said, mid-forties, cufflinks dull. Brutal charm gone spare. "Ash still speaks. Plane-desk messages may live in what didn't fully burn. Or hangar breach may matter more than soot."

[player_name]—early thirties, across the hall—catalogued greasy flakes and dread. Marcus Pell would call this controllable. Brooks would call it obstruction warming toward charges. Four fates open. Soft alibi smelled like smoke.

Choice: harden toward Brooks's ultimatum on ash evidence, or risk hangar breach before soot became the only map. Elevator freight chime. Black car. Wind sheer upstairs. Hope and dread shared the grate.

Ash forensics from a concierge grate was Crownspire's idea of a whisper that still burned fingers. [player_name] and Nolan leaned over soot that had been guest marks, thinning calendar proof, possibly plane-desk corners that refused to vanish clean. Rhea had chosen fire; fire had chosen incomplete erasure.

Brooks would smell obstruction. Pell would smell controllable narrative. Soft alibi smelled like smoke and perfume ghost upstairs still unused. Four fates open on purpose—Layer 6 allowed ash to accuse without settling Vivienne.

"Ultimatum or hangar," Nolan said quietly. "Soft still chooses which fire next."

Elevator freight. Black car. Wind sheer. Hope and dread shared the grate like co-authors in carbon.
hot:
Ash on [player_name]'s fingers while Nolan Greer's breath warmed her temple made forensics feel intimate and filthy—early thirties, soft alibi smoke-scented, mid-want rising in a service corridor where crime stayed plot and heat stayed body-true. Four fates open. Brooks colder without corpse. Romance locked on Nolan.

Cufflink tick. Thighs tight. She could face Brooks's ultimatum—or hangar breach—while unfinished ache hammered under silk. Mid-want ending in soot. She trembled choosing which verb got the next dangerous inch.

Ash on skin while his breath warmed her was intimacy Crownspire should not allow in service corridors. Soft alibi mid-want smoke-scented. She ached choosing Brooks steel or hangar cold while unfinished heat hammered. Romance locked on Nolan. Crime plot. Body-true. Unfinished on purpose.
